nAlerts.description: Number of active alerts shown in the counter; 0 shows the idle state.

alertType.description: The alert type that selects the icon and colours. The Cadre priorities map onto it as wiki 13 section 11.1 says: Critical level-critical, High alarm, Medium warning, Low caution, Diagnostic empty (no alert colour); level-high, level-medium and level-low draw the same colours as alarm, warning and caution. Empty draws the idle state.

type.description: Visual variant: flat (icon only), normal (default, icon and optional counter) or enhanced (emphasized for high-priority alerts).

large.description: Increases the button height and padding for touch-friendly or prominent use.

showSilenceButton.description: Whether the silence control is drawn beside the bell. False by default: no Cadre function silences an alarm, so the control stays hidden until one exists.

silenceButtonDisabled.description: Disables the silence button when true. Available when showSilenceButton==true.

counter.description: Shows the alert counter when there are active alerts and the button is not flat.

globalCounter.description: Shows the per-severity counts and the shelved count before the bell and the total (the item's global counter); a flat button shows the plain bell.

shelvedCount.description: Number of shelved alerts, shown after the global counter badges; hidden at zero. Available when globalCounter==true.

blinking.description: Flashes the bell for active alerts of a flashing alert type (never for caution).

flashingSpeed.description: Flash tempo while blinking is on: default resolves from alertType, fast, slow, very-slow force a tempo, fixed never flashes. Available when blinking==true.

flatMaxBreakpointPx.description: Window width in px below which a normal or enhanced button switches to flat mode. Available when type!=flat.

silenceButtonMinBreakpointPx.description: Minimum window width in px for showing the silence button. Available when showSilenceButton==true.

componentSize.description: OpenBridge component size: regular, medium, large or xl.
